workflow.critical: Execute through {project-root}/_arcwright/core/tasks/workflow.xml with {installed_path}/workflow.yaml loaded. Honor user/host scope, language, permissions, and interaction mode; reuse applicable AGENTS.md and the shared runtime.
Review the requested files, patch, commit/range, PR, or story. A story file is optional for a code-only review. Report evidence-backed findings without a minimum count.

step.goal: Resolve requirements and actual change scope
step.action: Use the supplied review target. If a story is part of it, read the story once and extract story_key, epic_num, acceptance criteria, task completion claims, and File List. Otherwise derive the changed contract from the request and code.

Read {project-root}/_arcwright/awm/resources/review-scope.md and resolve the actual base/head, committed changes, and task-owned local edits. Include requested workflow/configuration changes; preserve unrelated work. Ask only when an ambiguous range or overlapping edits materially changes the review.

Reuse applicable AGENTS.md and verifiable current context. Use discover_inputs selectively for relevant architecture, requirements, or UI gaps; do not preload all project documents or inactive host instruction files.

Load test-quality for test review, and selected domain/security guidance when relevant. Research an uncertain API or vulnerability claim with primary sources only when needed to establish the finding.

Compare acceptance criteria and completed-task claims with actual behavior, wiring, and appropriate verification evidence. Inspect every task-owned changed file and the integration paths needed to understand it. A missing worktree diff alone is not evidence that committed work is absent.

Check correctness, error/failure paths, authorization and data handling, material performance/concurrency risks, and test assertions. Distinguish a plausible defect from a stylistic preference, speculative refactor, or missing ledger entry.

Reuse existing relevant tests and results; run focused checks when needed to validate a concern, then any required gates for fixes. Do not create tests, run a broad suite, or add reviewers solely to produce more findings.

Give each finding a location, evidence, concrete impact, and severity based on that impact. Separate uncertainty as needs-verification. Deduplicate; a clean review is valid. No minimum issue quota or escalation because too few issues were found applies.

step.goal: Report findings and apply authorized repairs
step.output: Report target/base/source identity, verdict (approve, changes requested, or blocked), concrete findings by severity, observed checks, and material limits. If none, say no actionable findings were found in the reviewed scope.

check.if: the current user or selected workflow authorizes fixing review findings
check.action: Fix confirmed in-scope defects in severity order. Verify affected behavior and update the source-bound evidence/ledger. Decline optional or out-of-scope suggestions with a short reason; do not silently expand the change.

Honor the selected review/fix budget; absent another budget, use at most three rounds total. Later rounds cover changed code and open findings. Stop when material issues close; exhausted budget is not approval.

step.action: For a review-only request, return the findings without editing source, story, or sprint tracking. Ask only when consequential missing information or an action beyond authorization prevents continuation.

step.goal: Update authorized story tracking and close

check.if: story tracking updates are part of the authorized task and a story is present
check.action: Append concise Senior Developer Review notes or Review Follow-ups with neutral [Review][Severity] task labels. Do not add model names, attribution labels, generated-by notices, or coauthor trailers.

Mark done only when all acceptance criteria and required implementation, review, and validation gates pass. Keep incomplete implementation in-progress; use review for a pending required review. Record unresolved findings and failed/unrun checks accurately.
Update only the matching sprint entry when present, preserving comments, order, and unrelated story content. Keep File List and Change Log aligned with actual task-owned edits.

step.output: Return the final verdict, fixed/open findings, verification, and any remaining required work. Preserve required legal/source credits. Do not advance to another story, publish, push, or merge without existing authorization.
